business_problem: Maxon needed to add AI-driven 3D generation to Cinema 4D in a way that would accelerate professional creative workflows, scale globally, and keep artists in control despite skepticism about how AI should fit into established design practices.
solution_summary: Maxon is embedding Tencent Cloud's HY 3D Global model into Cinema 4D as an API-driven generative 3D service delivered directly inside the creative workflow. Artists on iPad and desktop stay in Cinema 4D while invoking HY 3D Global to generate or process high-quality 3D assets, so AI acts as a supportive assistant rather than a replacement for artist judgment. Tencent Cloud's global reach gives Maxon a way to deploy the same AI-enhanced experience to creators worldwide, while the API-based delivery model helps the company ship new features quickly and keep performance consistent across devices. The integration is framed as an artist-first architecture: Cinema 4D remains the main production surface, HY 3D Global supplies the generative engine, and the combined stack emphasizes transparency, speed, reliability, and creative flexibility for professional digital content creation.

solution_components.name: Cinema 4D

data_flow: Artists work inside Cinema 4D on iPad or desktop, call the HY 3D Global model through API-based services to generate or process 3D content, and receive the resulting assets back in the native modeling, animation, and rendering workflow.
business_outcome: Maxon brought scalable generative 3D AI into Cinema 4D's installed workflow, giving creators faster asset generation and processing while preserving artist control and global delivery consistency.
